# Gridfinity screw label (for Pred's bins)

Snap-in 12 mm label with a screw drawing (drive, head, length) and size text.

- Author: Nadia Santalla <nadia@santalla.io>, per the file header.
- License: GNU GPL v3.0 or later (stated in the file header).
- Source: supplied by the repository owner on 2026-10-03; kept byte-for-byte.
- The site renders `adapters/santalla-screw-label/Pred_GridfinityLabel.scad`, which only changes the BOSL include paths (the original points at a system folder), adds Customizer dropdowns, and picks a font the browser engine has. Same GPL license.
